members.name: routing
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to the support chat. Which specific topic is the customer's message about? Pick the single topic that best describes what the customer needs.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card purchase/payment on the statement that the customer says they did not make or do not recognise.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: An ATM cash withdrawal on the account that the customer says they did not make or do not recognise.
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer did not set up or does not recognise.
criteria.compromised_card: The customer thinks their card details were stolen, copied or used by someone else; suspicious activity on the card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The customer has lost their card or it was stolen and it is still missing; wants to block/freeze it or report it.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer lost their phone or it was stolen and worries about access to the banking app.
criteria.request_refund: The customer wants a refund for a purchase or wants to get money back from a merchant.
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund the merchant promised or issued has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.charged_twice: The same payment was taken twice / duplicate charge.
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The ATM gave out less (or different) cash than requested but debited the full amount.
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment the customer made was afterwards cancelled, reversed or returned (not refused at the moment of purchase) and the customer asks why.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained small extra amount or additional charge appears on the statement or on top of a transaction and the customer asks what it is; not a whole payment they say they never made, and not a fee they link to a card payment, transfer, ATM withdrawal, top-up or exchange.
criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card.
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using the card with Apple Pay, Google Pay or other phone wallets.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring soon; getting a replacement before expiry.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; whether shops/places take the card.
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was ordered has not arrived; tracking the card delivery.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; delivery options and dates for a new card.
criteria.card_linking: Linking/adding a card to the app or account; making a card visible in the app; re-adding a card that was found again.
criteria.card_not_working: The card has stopped working or is broken/damaged in general.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A purchase with the card, in a shop or online, was declined or rejected, including repeated declines at checkout.
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: Getting or using disposable (single-use) virtual cards and their limits.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working or being rejected.
criteria.physical_card: Ordering or getting a physical card; getting the first card.
criteria.card_pin: Questions about the PIN of a card: where to find the PIN of a new card, how the PIN is sent, what the PIN is.
criteria.spare_card: Getting additional or spare cards, cards for family members, a new or replacement card.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Any question that is about Visa versus Mastercard: which network the bank's card uses, whether Visa or Mastercard cards work with the service, or asking for a card on a particular network.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblocking the PIN.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used with the card; finding an ATM.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM refused/declined a cash withdrawal.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase still showing as pending, or a payment taking long to go through when the message does not say it is a transfer.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM withdrawal still showing as pending.
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: A bank transfer into the account has not updated the balance.
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: A cheque or cash deposit has not updated the balance / not cleared.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Can't add a payee/beneficiary; beneficiary not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling or stopping a transfer already made; transfer sent to wrong account.
criteria.declined_transfer: An outgoing bank transfer of money to another account or person was declined or not allowed (not a card purchase).
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or bounced back.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer the customer sent (money sent to an account or person) still pending; why the transfer is taking so long.
criteria.transfer_not_received: The recipient has not received a transfer the customer sent.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from others or getting paid into the account, including being paid (e.g. wages) in another currency.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account from another bank.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: setting it up, its limits.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or didn't work.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reversed/cancelled after it seemed to go through.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up with a card; top-up methods and options in general.
criteria.top_up_cash_cheque: Topping up with cash or cheque.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code or check needed for a card top-up.
criteria.payment_not_found: A payment is missing or the balance didn't change and the customer can't tell why.
criteria.card_payment_fee: The customer was charged a fee for making a card payment or purchase (including a payment that went through but had a fee added), or asks whether paying by card costs a fee.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee for taking out cash at an ATM.
criteria.exchange_charge: General question about what fees apply when exchanging currency or paying in a foreign currency (asking about pricing, not complaining about a specific past exchange).
criteria.exchange_overcharged: The customer complains that a specific past currency exchange cost them more than it should have or the exchange fee taken was wrong.
criteria.exchange_rate: General question about what exchange rates are used or how rates are set; not a complaint that the rate applied to the customer was wrong.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange or convert between currencies in the app.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the customer can hold or exchange in the account; supported currencies (not about receiving incoming payments).
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_card: The customer complains that the exchange rate applied to their purchase or payment was wrong or not what they expected (also when they do not say what kind of transaction it was, unless it was a cash withdrawal).
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_cash: An ATM withdrawal abroad used a wrong exchange rate.
criteria.top_up_fee: Fees for topping up by card or by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged for a transfer.
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Which currencies, and which kinds of outside cards, are supported for adding money or paying, when the question is not about Visa versus Mastercard.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account; accounts for children.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank operates in; whether people living in a given country can open an account or get the bank's card; using the service from abroad.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failing or not working.
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity; documents needed.
criteria.source_of_funds: Proving source of funds / where money comes from.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode; can't log in to the app.
